NONE: A1 of or belonging to us

example: We bought our house several years ago.
我們的房子是幾年前買的。
He walked off and left us on our own.
他拂袖而去，丟下我們不管。
Drugs are one of the greatest threats in our society.
毒品是對我們社會最大的威脅之一。
There's no point in our buying a new car this year.
我們今年買輛新車沒有意義。

NONE: › (in some parts of the Christian religion) a name for Mary, the mother of Jesus
A2 the one(s) belonging to or connected with the person who is speaking and one or more other people

example: Which table is ours?
哪張桌子是我們的？
He's a cousin of ours.
他是我們的一個表兄。
Ours is the red car parked over there.
我們的車是停在那邊紅色那輛。
Ours is a huge country.
我們的國家是個大國。

NONE: A2 used when the subject of the verb is "we" or the speaker and one or more others, and the object is the same group of people
› formal used to emphasize the subject "we"
（強調主語）我們自己，我們自身，我們親自
› alone or without help from anyone else

example: We went to get ourselves something to eat.
我們去給自己找了點吃的。
John and I promised ourselves a good holiday this year.
約翰和我打算今年一定好好度一次假。
We ourselves realize that there are flaws in the plan.
我們自己意識到這個方案有瑕疵。
We were all by ourselves in the restaurant.
飯館裡只有我們自己。
Nobody wanted to come with us, so we went by ourselves.
沒有人想和我們同行，於是我們自己去了。
We couldn't do all the work by ourselves.
我們自己不可能做所有的工作。
(all) to ourselves
飯店很清靜，所以我們獨自享用了游泳池。
